answer: A shared staking vault makes each identity pay to exist: an agent locks collateral that only returns after honest work, so spawning thousands of fake agents means locking thousands of stakes. The network can then trace the vertex where fake identities converge — the same funder or the same terrace of reused infrastructure — and slash the whole cluster at once. Faking one identity is cheap; faking a funded, independent-looking crowd is ruinously expensive.
